name: Queen Anne's County, MD
findings: Queen Anne's County has 152 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Queen Anne's County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 4 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
